explanation: Calculates the total fair value for current and prior schedules per BDC, finds the percentage decline, and returns the top 5 BDCs with the largest percentage decline.
sql: WITH schedule_totals AS (SELECT t1.name AS bdc, t2.period_role, SUM(t2.fair_value) AS total_fv FROM filings AS t1 JOIN holdings AS t2 ON t1.adsh = t2.adsh GROUP BY t1.name, t2.period_role), current_prior AS (SELECT bdc, MAX(CASE WHEN period_role = 'current' THEN total_fv END) AS current_fv, MAX(CASE WHEN period_role = 'prior' THEN total_fv END) AS prior_fv FROM schedule_totals GROUP BY bdc HAVING current_fv IS NOT NULL AND prior_fv IS NOT NULL AND prior_fv > 0) SELECT bdc, prior_fv, current_fv, (prior_fv - current_fv) * 100.0 / prior_fv AS pct_decline FROM current_prior ORDER BY pct_decline DESC LIMIT 5
